scenario: Engine-driven synthetic MOS/LIT/POL cohorts, not historical AI adoption or human playtest
source_basis: run3 snapshot and harness copied byte-for-byte; source head 2c967105471a8354558c32d9a2cf7a32d976ec2e

campaign_setup.country_faith: All three tags are explicitly converted to Greek Catholicism at setup.
campaign_setup.province_faith: MOS and POL start homogeneous Greek Catholic; LIT starts with Orthodox provinces except its capital.
campaign_setup.grants: Each cohort receives +300 ducats and +3 stability; starts PA at 0.60 then buys one icon and one synodal institution through live effects.
campaign_setup.observation: 630 monthly 30-day samples accumulate trigger eligibility, active icon/institution months, sampled PA, owned Orthodox/Greek Catholic province counts, and living Orthodox-country count.

instrumentation_caveat: The combined game.log sample string exceeds the engine's 512-character quoted-string limit, so periodic save counters are the evidence source. Eligibility is sampled every 30 days and can miss short windows between samples. Active-month totals give lower bounds, not exact purchase counts. Province totals and Orthodox-country survival are confounded by AI war, annexation, and land transfers; this is not a conversion-rate or causal opposition test.
